variables.physical_definition: Free-stream velocity: the characteristic velocity of the undisturbed flow far from the boundary layer.
Kinematic viscosity: dynamic viscosity divided by fluid density, governing viscous diffusion of momentum.
Integrated mean-flow kinetic energy per unit density defined as the integral from the wall to delta of U^2 dy (i.e., ∫_0^delta U^2 dy).
Boundary layer thickness (δ): the distance from the wall to the point where the mean velocity reaches 99% of the free-stream velocity.
Displacement thickness (δ*): the integral measure of the boundary layer thickness defined as ∫_0^delta (1 - U/U_inf) dy.
Momentum thickness (θ): the integral measure of momentum deficit in the boundary layer defined as ∫_0^delta (U/U_inf)(1 - U/U_inf) dy.
